Reality: the U.S. is turning the Philippines into the tip of the spear for a future war over Taiwan and the South China Sea. Manila thinks it’s upgrading to ‘frontline ally’ Pentagon docs read more like: ‘disposable missile sponge, now with better PR  🇵🇭🚀

The Feb 17 U.S.-Philippine maritime dialogue isn’t about “security”—it’s about turning a nation into collateral for Washington’s Cold War 2.0 escalation sequence https://t.co/Dzr7U22xxZ

The U.S. has already brought in the Typhon mid-range system—Tomahawks and SM-6s able to hit targets on the Chinese mainland—and is adding NMESIS anti-ship launchers in northern Luzon, facing Taiwan Island
​
But in press releases “Cutting-edge missiles and unmanned systems” sounds nicer than “first-strike launchpad that makes your towns priority targets

During a Conflict (for which the US is holding the detonator) the Philippines gets hit first. A Filipino military source said it best: “We’re the target, not the shield”

Meanwhile the US script writes itself: “Chinese aggression,” “illegal and coercive activities,” “mutual defense" blah blah blah..

Yet it’s Washington moving long-range offensive strike systems 11,000 km from home, using a relatively poor country as cheap, forward real estate to threaten China’s coast and “reassure” Taiwan Island—while the US homeland stays comfortably out of range

Of course the deployment comes with the usual hypocrisy and doublespeak; while Washington preaches “sovereignty” it is treating Manila like a chess piece. Bong Bong Marcos’ approval rating? Dropping to 25% and falling. But he’s doubling down—for US FMF cash, not Filipino lives. As the ASEAN chair in 2026; he is now chairing a regional arms race

And for those still claiming:  “The Typhon System is defensive”

DoD’s own LRPF program (Congress CRS Report IF12135) and Army Pacific testimony confirm Typhon is built for OFFENSIVE land/anti-ship strikes—Tomahawk 1,609km range, SM-6 anti-ship capability. Not ‘defense’—offensive projection. Source: https://t.co/MUa5Kj47RN

Key Offensive Details:
Explicitly frames Typhon (SMRF/MRC) as part of the U.S. Army’s Long-Range Precision Fires (LRPF) program—a core offensive modernization initiative 

Confirms Typhon is modified to launch Tomahawk cruise missiles (land-attack, 1,609km range) and SM-6 missiles (anti-ship/land-strike, 370km range) for offensive precision strikes

States its mission: “Hit targets at ranges between PrSM and hypersonic weapons—filling the Army’s offensive mid-range fire gap”

And according to the DoD Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2) Doctrine https://t.co/SBcT6plPOr (now deleted by the War Dept)

Typhon is explicitly listed as a “key offensive enabler” for JADC2—DoD’s global strike network—designed to “deliver precision fires from land to sea/land targets in real time”

data.text:
PAHAYAG 
February 18, 2026

Mga kababayan, Assalamu Alaykum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh!
Madayaw ug maayong adlaw kaninyong tanan.
Magandang araw sa inyong lahat.

Proverbs 19 verse 21 states, “Many are the plans in a person's heart but it is the Lord's purpose that prevails”. It took me 47 years to understand that my life was never meant to be only mine. Unlike others, I may not have been born to chase happiness. For a long time, I questioned the weight of responsibility to my family, to my country, and to everyone who called on me.

Today, I have peacefully accepted that my life is unlike any other. 

Sa unang mga buwan palang ng aming termino, nakita ko na ang kawalan ng katapatan ni Bongbong Marcos Jr., sa mga pangakong binitawan noong kampanya, pati na sa kanyang sinumpaang tungkulin para sa bayan. Dahil hindi ko kinayang maging bahagi ng 2025 National Budget na tadtad ng katiwalian, pinili kong umalis sa gabinete kahit alam ko na mula pa noong 2023 na ang magiging kapalit nito ay ang aking impeachment.

Mga kababayan, humihingi ako ng paumanhin. 

Patawad kung tinulungan kong mahalal si BBM bilang Pangulo ng Pilipinas. Patawad kung hanggang ngayon ay marami pa ring Pilipino ang nalulunod sa baha ng dahil sa malawakang korapsyon. Patawad kung lantaran ang pang-aabuso sa ating mga institusyon para sa pansariling interes ng mga politiko. Patawad kung patuloy ang pagtaas ng presyo ng mga pangunahing bilihin habang nananatiling kapos ang kita ng bawat pamilya. Patawad kung wala man lang tayong tunay na seguridad sa pagkain. Patawad kung may mga nagkakasakit at binabawian bigla ng buhay dahil sa kakulangan ng maayos at epektibong healthcare system.  

Patawad kung ang mga dinadaanan ninyong kalsada, tulay, at proyektong pinondohan ng taong-bayan ay madalas masira. Patawad kung ang krimen, iligal na droga, at terorismo ay tila unti-unti nang lumalapit sa pintuan ng ating mga tahanan. At patawad kung wala tayong malinaw at tunay na independent foreign policy kung kaya’t tila tayo'y naiipit sa tunggaliang namamagitan sa mga super powers tulad ng Tsina at Estados Unidos.  

Madalas iniiwasan ng mga politiko ang maagang paghayag ng kanilang mga plano upang hindi sila maging target ng pag atake, ngunit matagal nang sinira ng administrasyong ito ang pangalan ko. Matagal na akong inaatake gamit ang buong makinarya ng kapangyarihan— mula sa mga scripted na imbestigasyon na ibinalot sa katagang ‘in aid of legislation’, sa pagkidnap ng aking ama, hanggang sa mga samu’t-saring paratang na pilit inuulit-ulit hanggang magmukhang totoo. 

Marahil ay matagal na rin akong hinatulan sa mata ng iilan. Hindi ako kailanman natakot sa pagsira nila ng pangalan ko. Ngunit may takot ako para sa ating mga anak. May takot ako para sa mga susunod na henerasyon. May takot ako para sa mga kababayan nating walang bahay sa ibang bansa, walang pangalawang pasaporte, walang ibang matatakbuhan kundi ang Pilipinas—kahit ito’y patuloy na nalulugmok sa kahirapan. 

Naa ko'y kahadlok nga muabot ang adlaw nga dawaton na lang nato ang kapobrehon isip kapalaran, nga maanad na ta sa sayop, nga mawad-an na lang ta og paglaom. Ug labaw sa tanan, naa ko'y kahadlok nga muabot ang adlaw nga wala na tay Pilipinas nga ikahatag sa atong mga anak. 

I cannot kneel before each and every Filipino to beg for forgiveness. Instead, I offer my life, my strength, and my future in the service of our nation. 

Mga kababayan, ibalik natin ang tapang at malasakit— para sa Diyos, para sa Bayan, at para sa bawat Pamilyang Pilipino. Ako si Sara Duterte, tatakbo bilang Pangulo ng Pilipinas.

Shukran.

SARA Z. DUTERTE
Vice President of the Philippines

▫️Major Active Volcanoes of the World

Volcanoes are surface expressions of plate tectonics. Their global distribution is not random. They are concentrated along plate boundaries, especially around the Pacific.

🌋 Global Distribution Pattern

1️⃣ Pacific Ring of Fire
•Horseshoe-shaped belt around the Pacific Ocean.
•Covers western coasts of North & South America and eastern margins of Asia & Australia.
•Accounts for ~75% of the world’s active volcanoes.
•Associated with subduction zones (convergent plate boundaries).

Examples:
Mount Fuji (Japan), Krakatoa (Indonesia), Mount St. Helens (USA), Mount Pinatubo (Philippines), Sakurajima (Japan).

2️⃣ Mid-Ocean Ridges
•Divergent plate boundaries.
•Volcanism mainly submarine.
•Example: Iceland (Laki fissures), Mid-Atlantic Ridge.

3️⃣ Hotspots
•Intra-plate volcanism.
•Caused by mantle plumes.
•Example: Hawaii (Kilauea), Reunion Island.

🌍 Important Active Volcanoes (Exam Relevant)
•Krakatoa (Indonesia) – Located in Sunda Strait; explosive history (1883 eruption).
•Mount Etna (Italy) – Europe’s most active volcano.
•Mount Vesuvius (Italy) – Destroyed Pompeii (79 AD).
•Kilauea (Hawaii, USA) – Shield volcano; hotspot origin.
•Barren Island (India) – Only active volcano in India (Andaman & Nicobar).
•Mount Erebus (Antarctica) – Southernmost active volcano.

🌋 The Ring of Fire – Significance
•Formed due to subduction of Pacific Plate beneath surrounding plates.
•Zone of intense volcanic eruptions and earthquakes.
•High frequency of tsunamis (e.g., 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami was related to subduction activity though outside Pacific core).
•Influences global climate during major eruptions (e.g., ash and sulphur aerosols → cooling effect).

🌍 Types of Volcanoes (Exam Angle)
•Shield Volcanoes – Gentle slopes; basaltic lava (Hawaii).
•Composite/Stratovolcanoes – Explosive; andesitic lava (Ring of Fire).
•Cinder Cones – Smaller, steep-sided.

🔎 Previous Year Question Themes

🔹 Prelims
1.Which is the only active volcano in India? → Barren Island.
2.The Ring of Fire is associated with which ocean? → Pacific Ocean.
3.Iceland’s volcanism is associated with which boundary? → Divergent plate boundary.

🔹 Mains
•Discuss the causes and distribution of volcanoes around the world.
•Explain the relationship between plate tectonics and volcanic activity.

🚨During a major fire in Mandaue City, Cebu, Philippines, a woman refused to leave her home without rescuing her dogs. As the blaze intensified, she climbed a ladder, tossed each dog to safety, and then dangled from a railing until firefighters could reach her. She escaped with only minor injuries, and all her dogs survived thanks to her determination and love.

Many people have called her a hero for putting her pets’ safety above her own fear.

It raises an important question: Would you risk your life to save your pets, or would fear keep you back?
